description: One of the 102 play spaces Newcastle City Council looks after, listed as Paddy Freeman's Park (Fenced). The council lists Paddy Freeman's Park (Fenced) and Paddy Freeman's Park (Open) here. The council's playground team checks its play spaces every week.
